We need to read the problem statement carefully: "Find the Minimum Sum of a Pair of Numbers from nums such that the Maximum Digit in Both Numbers are Not Equal"

We have to find min sum of a pair (i, j) where the maximum digit (i.e., the largest decimal digit appearing in the number) of nums[i] is not equal to the maximum digit of nums[j].

Return the minimum sum; if no such pair, return -1.

Constraints: nums.length up to 100, each value up to 10^4 (i.e., at most 5 digits). So O(n^2) scanning all pairs is fine: 100^2 = 10k.
